targets.title: Storybook rules
targets.description: Rules for writing Storybook stories and interaction tests for React components in CSF Next: how to query, when to use .test() or play, portals, naming and file setup. Background knowledge for agents that write or review stories; not a command.
targets.intro: Apply these rules to every story file you write or review. The first section is always in force; open a file from the table when the task touches it.

targets.title: Test data builder rules (TypeScript, mimicry-js)
targets.description: Rules for building test data in TypeScript with mimicry-js builders: explicit values for everything a test asserts on, .one() and .many() with overrides and traits, generator placement, resetting state. Background knowledge for agents that write tests or stories; not a command.
targets.intro: Apply these rules whenever you create or use a builder in a TypeScript test or story.

targets.title: Test data factory rules (Python, factory_boy)
targets.description: Rules for building test data in Python with factory_boy: explicit values for everything a test asserts on, keyword overrides and Traits, build() versus create(), resetting state. Background knowledge for agents that write Python tests; not a command.
targets.intro: Apply these rules whenever you create or use a factory in a Python test.
